title: LIVE UPDATES: Rodrigo Duterte at ICC Third Status Conference (Sept.16, 2026)
summary: Live updates during the Third Status Conference in the case of former president Rodrigo Duterte before the International Criminal Court Trial Chamber III on September 16, 2026.

blocks.text: Former Philippines president Rodrigo Duterte appears before the International Criminal Court, as the court hears arguments regarding Duterte's health and ability to stand trial, while he faces murder charges related to his war on drugs, in The Hague, Netherlands, September 16 2026. REUTERS/Piroschka van de Wouw/Pool
Ex-Pres. Duterte attends ICC status conference for the first time
Former President Rodrigo Duterte attended, for the first time this Wednesday, September 16, 2026, the International Criminal Court’s (ICC) status conference in his crimes against humanity case.
